coordinate_system: Original Blender rig, meters, Z up/front -Y. Runtime converts [x,y,z] to [x,z,-y].
source_frames: Native frames 1..151 map to runtime frames 0..150 at 30 fps (five seconds).

clip.json.interpretation: Explicit authored staging choices, source limits and relevant display notes.
clip.json.skinning: linear or dualQuaternion; omitted means linear

cameras.json: Array of exactly2objects{label,position:[x,y,z],target:[x,y,z],scale}; orthographic horizontal world width, fit all phases with readable relevant muscles/contacts.
pose-samples.json: Array of{id,frame,joints:{<bone-name>:[x,y,z]}}; frame is runtime frame0..150. Include all51bones at start, intermediates, hold and return.
notes: Interface examples are not literal measurements or patch indices. Record the measured actual deformed-skin minimum in global_floor_z and the separate support plane in floor_plane_z. Keep original 51-bone binding/Basis/rest/UV/source IDs. Declare each local POSITION/NORMAL corrective and its default/animated weight. Native Smooth/Multires previews are separate from the explicitly chosen runtime linear or DQ cage. 6033 has tuck/extend phases; 4348 is intentionally static and retains the source 15–30-second hold. Do not invent motion merely to satisfy a generic movement test.
dq-reference.json.gz: For DQ assets only: {source_sha256,source_vertices:10582,samples:[{id,frame,positions:[[x,y,z],...]}]}; all original IDs in order, at frames 0/30/75/120/150 with only Armature enabled. Include current pose-corrective influences.
